ABOUT ME

Actor. Storyteller. Aspiring Director.

I believe every character deserves honesty. Acting isn't just about performing dialogue; it's about understanding emotions, connecting with people and bringing stories to life on screen.

Alongside acting, I'm passionately learning the craft of filmmaking and direction, exploring every aspect of cinema from script to screen.

This page reflects my journey, performances, experiences and the continuous pursuit of becoming a better artist every day.

CHARACTER GALLERY

Personalities.

Every role tells a different story. Here are some of the characters I can portray.

Police Officer

Calm, disciplined and authoritative. Suitable for Police, SI, CI and IPS roles.

Investigation Officer

Serious, intelligent and observant. Ideal for crime thrillers and investigative stories.

Action Character

Rugged, fearless and intense. Built for action-packed performances.

Family Man

Warm, emotional and relatable. Perfect for family-oriented dramas.

Corporate Professional

Confident, professional and sophisticated. Suitable for executive and business roles.

Lead Character

Romantic, emotional and versatile. Ready for protagonist roles across genres.

Screen Presence

A collection of different looks, expressions and personalities for diverse casting requirements.
